errors.BATCH_SIZE_INVALID: That is more files than your plan allows in one batch.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: One of the files is larger than your plan allows.
errors.DAILY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: Your daily allowance is spent, so this batch could not be started. Nothing was compressed — try again tomorrow with a smaller batch.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This batch was already started with a different set of files.
errors.BATCH_NOT_ADMITTABLE: This batch can no longer accept files.
errors.FILE_NOT_MEASURED: One of the uploads did not finish. Start a new batch.
errors.ENTITLEMENTS_UNAVAILABLE: Plan limits are temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This batch is gone — results are not kept after you leave the page. Start a new one.
errors.STORAGE_REJECTED: The upload was refused. Start a new batch.
errors.STORAGE_UNREACHABLE: Could not reach storage. Check your connection and try again.
errors.BATCH_TOKEN_MISMATCH: This batch belongs to a different visitor.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests in a row. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Could not reach Pixaeron. Check your connection and try again.

notice.leaving: Results are held in this tab only. If you leave, you lose access to them.
